label: GO step, choosing a1 after a rewarded a1 trial (mid-episode, trials 10-59)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), never at D1 or D2. Every activation comes after a rewarded previous trial (prev_reward==1, 100%) in which the agent chose a1 (or the window is starting), and the agent is about to choose a1 again (99.7% of mass has action==1; model_act==1 at GO gives the same scores and is observed, so I recorded that rather than the future action). Mass is concentrated in episode trials 10-59, peaking at 20-39; it is essentially silent after trial 60, and in trials 0-9 too. It favours S1-good blocks (86% of mass) and high value (7.7-8.1) / strongly a1-favouring policy logits. Within a run of consecutive rewarded a1 trials the activation builds up trial by trial (e.g. 0.82 -> 0.90 -> 0.95 -> 0.98). It does not fire on a2 choices, after unrewarded trials, or after a2 trials. Recall and mass recall are ~0.99, but precision is only ~0.2: false positives look identical to true positives in every listed variable (same reward/choice history, same block), so the threshold crossing depends on a slowly drifting hidden-state component (episode-time and streak length) not captured by the variables. Requiring the previous two trials to be rewarded a1 raises F1 only to 0.38. A coherent "rewarded-a1 repeat" description, but the exact firing is better read as magnitude.
